dict.string: When enabled, AI-bot reads the current track and controls playback in Music or Spotify for your paired TAB5. Explicit lock requests use System Events.
AI-bot connects to your paired clock and provides authenticated Wi-Fi fallback on your local network.
AI-bot connects to your USB-paired TAB5 to exchange authenticated display data and device requests over Bluetooth.
When explicitly enabled, AI-bot transcribes your TAB5 or Mac microphone locally for review before you choose to send or insert the text.
AI-bot records the Mac default microphone only after you start an authorized TAB5 voice session.
